title: Cancelled Stops
statement: A delivery route is a linked list of street numbers. Roadworks close one street, `closed`, and the driver must skip every stop on it. Remove all nodes whose value equals `closed` and return the head of the route that is left (null if nothing is left). Keep the other stops in their order.

answerKey.pattern: Dummy node before head, then unlink matching nodes in one pass
keyPoints: Put a dummy node in front of head so the first stop is removed like any other
Keep a pointer prev at the last kept node
If prev.next has the closed value, skip it with prev.next = prev.next.next; otherwise move prev forward
edgeCases: Removed stops next to each other
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Copy the kept values into a new list: O(n) time but O(n) extra space

hints: Removing a node means changing the pointer of the node before it. What is before the head?
Add a dummy node in front of head. Now every real node has a node before it.
Only move prev forward when you keep prev.next. After removing, check the new prev.next again.
